app_fee.value: Monash University does not charge an application fee for Graduate Research applications.

fee_waiver.value: No application fee is charged, so no waiver is stated.

gre_general.value: No GRE requirement is stated for graduate research degrees at Monash University.

toefl_min.value: Recognised English test score thresholds are set by course and specified on the university website.
toefl_min.quote: 1.12.2 achievement of minimum scores on a recognised English test as specified on the University website.

ielts_min.value: Recognised English test score thresholds are set by course and specified on the university website.
ielts_min.quote: 1.12.2 achievement of minimum scores on a recognised English test as specified on the University website.

english_waiver.value: English requirements may be met by successful completion of a tertiary course of study with minimum duration of two years full-time in English.
english_waiver.quote:
Where an applicant’s first language is not English, the minimum ELP requirements for entry to graduate research courses may be
met if the applicant demonstrates satisfaction of:
1.12.1 successful completion of a tertiary course of a study with a minimum duration of two years full-time and in accordance with
any requirements specified on the University website;

notes: Monash University doctoral programs are governed centrally by the Graduate Research Admissions Procedure (DMS 2723244) and the Graduate Research Committee.
